opt3_commit_note: Research opt/solid-opt3-followup HEAD reported by integration owner. Cached algorithm predates followup (frozen opt/solid-opt3 e9ead63); exact original file SHA256s below are authoritative.

archived_evidence.resolution: Use the manifest source records and bundled extractor to resolve original source_root/path to archive parts/members and verify SHA256.

Darwin.scope: Historical opt2 production driver rates, not opt3 kernel-only rates. Current opt2 driver starts wall0 after equilibration and reports elapsed after NPZ close, so it includes snapshot and NPZ work; old bench README says otherwise. No Apple Fast<K> performance claim.

non-Darwin.algorithm: opt3 Fast<true> K cache with occupied-type fast path
non-Darwin.old_hash_scope: cpu/Makefile.fast hashes concatenated fast.cpp, frozen headers, Makefile.fast, and compiler/flags. It is not the single-file SHA256 of fast.cpp; that is recorded under origins.cached_algorithm.
non-Darwin.scope: Historical kernel-only steady_clock including sweep timer checks; excludes initialization, thresholds, warmup, byte export, NPZ. Timed work differs by run. Not fixed-work A/B/B/A, no clock/cycle measurement, historical development seed, not a held-out key. Packaged production host is newly adapted and has not been built, gated, or measured.
non-Darwin.old_oracle_receipt: artifact://869; REPORT.md:143-159 records full frozen-oracle matrix ok:true; not rerun

implementation.kernel_copy: opt3 cpu/fast.cpp lines 19..200 copied verbatim into fast.hpp; namespace closer and required includes added. Standalone benchmark/check main is not packaged.
implementation.host_origin: opt3 cuda/driver.cpp standalone segment, parsing, raw-state validation, NPZ I/O; stored ZIP writer from opt2 cpu/driver.cpp. GPU, batch campaign, and benchmark-specific code omitted.
implementation.apple_hot_path: Calls unchanged frozen common/sweeps_cpu.hpp functions with exact energy held across segments; no exp or full energy scan in proposal/sweep loop.
implementation.nonapple_hot_path: One persistent Fast<true> per chain and frozen geometry; draw64/indexAt preserve uint64 modulo proposal arithmetic. No allocation, byte reconstruction, or exp per attempt. Canonical bytes rebuilt only at segment boundaries.
implementation.ordering: For both mode: N nonlocal proposals then N physical random-nearest-neighbor local proposals for each absolute sweep; chain ids are zero-based row indices.
implementation.abi: driver L beta rho rho1 rho2 SWEEPS CHAINS CPU MODE EQUIL [STATE_RAW] --seed U64 --start-sweep U64 --history-every N --max-history-samples N
implementation.resume: Pass prior final canonical chain-major uint8 bytes as STATE_RAW, identical L/chains/beta/mode/seed, EQUIL=0, --start-sweep=prior next_sweep. Proposal arithmetic intentionally retains frozen modulo-u64 behavior; exported next_sweep must not overflow u64.
implementation.output: run.npz; preserves initial/equilibrated/final, snapshots, relative history_sweeps, float energy/acceptance, scalars/meta/seed. Adds exact energy_int/accept_*_count, history_sweeps_absolute, start_sweep/next_sweep, beta_text, cpu_backend, source_hash.
implementation.bounds: L=4..21; positive chains; no GPU fallback. Histories retain <=max-history-samples samples per chain including final sweep; segment scratch <=4096 sweeps per chain. Snapshots at powers of two plus final (<=65), independent of wall time. Stored ZIP rejects >4GiB instead of truncating.
implementation.dependencies: C++17 compiler, pthreads, header-only Boost.Multiprecision; Makefile detects /opt/homebrew/include, /usr/local/include, /usr/include; override BOOST_INC or CPPFLAGS. Install brew boost or Debian/Ubuntu libboost-dev. No Boost library link. Native ISA build requires running on compatible CPU.
implementation.build: make -C solid-final/cpu emits cpu/driver; Darwin uses opt2 O2/native, other POSIX systems opt3 K O3/native. No PGO/training/test/simulation targets.

qualification: Existing scientific kernels and old evidence have been packaged, not rerun. No performance or correctness claim is made for a newly compiled packaged executable.
